author: parithosh
content:
pq-devnet-0 halted at 04:23:33 UTC: every slot since has been missed, last finalized epoch 119.

 1. XMSS signing-tree boundary at slot 4096. The precomputed XMSS cache only covers slot duties for slots 0–4095. At slot 4096 every key needs a new signing tree. lodestar's VC
 builds it for all its keys at once on a 4-thread pool that it shares with signing and DNS, and that stalled it from 04:02:48 to 04:23:33. prysm and grandine hosts were at
 80–100% CPU from about 04:10 to 04:24. Participation fell to 37% and then 27%, so the main chain never justified epoch 126.

 2. geth's 32-block reorg limit. At 04:23:33 lodestar-geth-2 finally published blocks 4070 and 4075, built 19 minutes earlier. They justified epoch 126 on their branch, so every
 CL reorged 98 slots onto those blocks. Both blocks are EMPTY, so geth has to roll its head back 54 blocks along its own chain. geth v1.17.10 refuses that by default
 (--engine.maxreorgdepth=32, error -38006), so no node can build a block.

 Timeline (UTC)
 - 04:02:48: epoch 127 starts and lodestar's VC begins building the tree and stops signing.
 - 04:04 / 04:05: lodestar-geth-2's beacon node builds blocks 4070 and 4075 on time; the VC doesn't publish them.
 - 04:09–04:23: slot 4096 passes; participation is 37%, then 27%. The main chain never justifies epoch 126.
 - 04:23:33: 4070 and 4075 are published, epoch 126 is justified on their branch, and every CL reorgs 4167 → 4075.
 - 04:23:33 → now: every geth logs Refusing too deep reorg, depth 53–54 > 32, and no blocks are produced.

 Fix: restart every geth with --engine.maxreorgdepth=0. For XMSS, build the next signing tree ahead of time and in the background, off the signing threads. The next boundary is
 slot 12288 (~27 h after 4096).

 Full analysis: https://panda-uploads-production.devops-539.workers.dev/panda/uploads/6dafc3/pq-devnet-0-incident.html
